claims.disproof_condition: 若到 2027-06-30 前，Jabil 或 Sivers 未公開揭露此 1.6T LRO 模組完成客戶端 qualification 或開始出貨/認列營收，或雙方合作被公開終止/改用其他雷射供應商，則此合作路徑視為停滯，需重新評估。核查頻率：每季雙方法說會/新聞稿；觸發後 48 小時內確認最新揭露並更新 qualification_status 或 retire。
claims.statement: Sivers 與 Jabil 於 2026-04-15 官方新聞稿宣布合作開發使用 Sivers DFB 雷射的 1.6T LRO（linear receive optical）pluggable 光收發模組，鎖定次世代 hyperscale AI 資料中心；新聞稿本身未揭露具體出貨時程或量產規模，屬開發階段合作宣布，非已確認營收。

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Jabil 或 Sivers 後續新聞稿、法說或產品頁把這顆 1.6T 模組改寫成 LPO（收發兩端都不用 DSP）或全重定時（接收端放回 DSP），或寫明專案改成另一種架構。核查頻率：每季（Jabil、Sivers 法說與新聞稿）。觸發後 48 小時：e3 改接正確的 tech 節點或提撤回；重讀 LRO 層讀圖的供給側與 Sivers 敘事。
claims.statement: Sivers Semiconductors press release (2026-04-15): 'Jabil plans to develop a 1.6T linear receive optical (LRO) transceiver module using Sivers' high-performance Distributed Feedback (DFB) lasers', and Jabil's photonics VP says the collaboration will let Jabil 'deliver a 1.6T LRO solution'. The Jabil module is therefore one implementation of LRO (transmit-side DSP retiming, linear receive side), not a separate architecture or a separate layer. Development stage: no qualification, shipment, volume or DSP vendor is disclosed.

source_doc.permission_basis: Official public press release; store the canonical URL and only the research-relevant excerpt.
source_doc.title: Sivers Semiconductors Collaborates With Jabil on Energy Efficient 1.6T Pluggable Optical Transceiver Module

sources.quote: Jabil plans to develop a 1.6T linear receive optical (LRO) transceiver module using Sivers' high-performance Distributed Feedback (DFB) lasers.
The new pluggable module will provide highly energy efficient optical interconnect speeds to accelerate deployment for next generation hyperscale AI data centers.
Working with Sivers will allow us to deliver a 1.6T LRO solution that meets both data center performance and power targets at scale.
